source_basis: USDA AMS Harmonized GAP Field Operations and Harvesting checklist - leafy greens commodity-specific items
California LGMA / Arizona LGMA Accepted Food Safety Practices (cross-referenced for tightened thresholds)
FDA Produce Safety Rule subpart E (water) and subpart F (biological soil amendments) interpretations for leafy greens

merge_semantics.rule: Engine loads base scheme + overlay. Overlay can ADD new controls or TIGHTEN existing thresholds (lower allowed levels, higher frequency, shorter intervals, additional evidence). Overlay MUST NOT relax any base control.
merge_semantics.id_namespace: Overlay control ids start with HGAP.LG.* and are distinct from base ids. Where an overlay control supersedes a base control, the overlay control sets supersedes_base_id pointing at the base id.
merge_semantics.evidence_kind_vocabulary: Inherits from base ruleset; overlay does not introduce new kinds in v1.

controls.title: Mandatory no-harvest buffer around fecal contamination events
controls.description: When fecal contamination from animals (livestock, deer, geese, dogs) is observed in a leafy greens block, a no-harvest buffer is established around the contamination point. Default minimum buffer radius is 5 feet (1.5 m); document the buffer used and rationale if other than the default.

evidence_spec.guidance: Buffer event log: block, date, contamination type, buffer radius applied, decision-maker.
Photo of flagged buffer with reference object for scale.
If buffer radius differs from 5 ft default, attach written rationale referenced to LGMA / company SOP.

references.label: AMS HGAP Field Operations - leafy greens animal intrusion guidance
LGMA Accepted Food Safety Practices - Animal Intrusion

controls.title: Significant intrusion event triggers crew supervisor + food safety review
controls.description: Where animal evidence in a leafy greens block exceeds a threshold of significance (e.g. multiple piles, large mammal incursion, livestock break-in), the crew supervisor halts harvest in the affected area and the food safety responsible person makes the harvest/no-harvest decision before resumption.

evidence_spec.guidance: Significant event log: block, date, event description, crew action, food-safety decision, decision-maker, time of resumption (if any).

controls.subsection: Agricultural Water - Leafy Greens Testing Frequency
controls.title: Tightened microbial testing frequency for water contacting harvestable portion
controls.description: For leafy greens, water that contacts the harvestable portion (overhead irrigation, foliar spray carriers, harvest-aid water) is tested for generic E. coli at least monthly during the use season, in addition to base scheme requirements. Surface water sources require pre-season profile of at least 5 samples within 30 days before first use.

evidence_spec.guidance: Monthly water test results: source id, sample date, generic E. coli MPN/100mL, lab id.
Pre-season profile lab report (>=5 samples in 30 days) for each surface water source.

references.label: AMS HGAP Field Operations - leafy greens water guidance
FDA Produce Safety Rule subpart E - covered produce

controls.title: Threshold for water test action on leafy greens
controls.description: Any single agricultural water sample for leafy greens exceeding 126 CFU generic E. coli per 100 mL triggers immediate corrective action: stop use of that source for direct-contact applications until two consecutive resamples are below threshold, or apply a documented die-off interval before harvest.

evidence_spec.guidance: Water exceedance event log: source, date, result, action taken, resample dates and results, harvest impact decision.
Lab reports for the exceedance sample and resamples.

references.label: FDA Produce Safety Rule water quality criterion

controls.subsection: Harvest Equipment - Leafy Greens Sanitation Cadence
controls.title: Daily sanitation of harvest knives, blades, and food-contact surfaces
controls.description: Harvest knives, machine blades, conveyor belts, and other food-contact surfaces used on leafy greens are cleaned and sanitized at the start of each harvest day and after any contamination event (animal intrusion, soil contact, breakage). Sanitizer concentration is measured and recorded.

evidence_spec.guidance: Daily sanitation log: date, equipment, sanitizer, measured concentration, signer.
Sanitizer concentration test strip / titration reading per cleaning event.
Photo of sanitized equipment ready for the day.

references.label: AMS HGAP Field Operations - leafy greens harvest equipment

controls.title: Flooded leafy greens are not harvested
controls.description: Any portion of a leafy greens block that has been flooded with surface water of unknown quality during the production cycle is excluded from harvest. The exclusion decision is documented and the area is not returned to leafy greens production until risk assessment supports it.

evidence_spec.guidance: Flood event log: block, date, area affected, water source, exclusion decision, decision-maker.
Photos of flooded area at time of event.
If land is later returned to production, attach the post-event risk assessment.

references.label: FDA Produce Safety Rule - growing area flooded with pooled water

controls.title: Raw / untreated manure is not applied to leafy greens production blocks
controls.description: Raw or untreated biological soil amendments of animal origin are not applied to land used for leafy greens production within the same crop cycle. Composted amendments must meet process documentation per base control HGAP.FO.3.1.

evidence_spec.guidance: Soil amendment application log scoped to leafy greens blocks; should show no untreated amendments in current crop cycle.
Reviewer attestation that policy is documented in operation's food safety program.

references.label: AMS HGAP Field Operations - leafy greens soil amendments

controls.subsection: Harvest - Pre-Harvest Risk Walk for Leafy Greens
controls.title: Documented pre-harvest risk walk within 24 hours of harvest
controls.description: A documented pre-harvest risk walk is performed within 24 hours of harvest start for each leafy greens block, covering animal intrusion evidence, water/flooding evidence, foreign material, adjacent land activity, and crew readiness.

evidence_spec.guidance: Pre-harvest risk walk record: block, walk date/time, walker, observations (per category), action.
Optional photo of any flagged areas or buffers placed.
